info.title: Federal Government Contracts: SAM.gov + Grants.gov in one
info.description:
Which government contracts were posted today? Returns SAM.gov and Grants.gov notices in one feed, new-since-last-run deltas, and source links.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed

application/json.schema:
{
  "title": "GovCon Opportunity Feed input",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "title": "Mode",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "monitor",
        "snapshot",
        "enrich",
        "rehashState"
      ],
      "default": "monitor",
      "description": "snapshot (Store QA prefill): serve matching opportunities from the published HF snapshot. monitor: serve HF delta events with eventDate >= since (near-$0 on a quiet window). enrich: snapshot plus future incumbent overlays (deferred in 0.1.32). rehashState: no-op on the public Actor (stateless; private producer only).",
      "prefill": "snapshot"
    },
    "sources": {
      "title": "Sources",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [
        "sam",
        "grants"
      ],
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Allowed values: sam, grants. SAM defaults to daily Data Services CSV (samBulk=true, no key). Grants.gov needs no key.",
      "prefill": [
        "sam"
      ]
    },
    "samApiKey": {
      "title": "SAM.gov API key",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "isSecret": true,
      "description": "Optional when samBulk=true. Required only for API enrich (resourceLinks) / monitor checks / samBulk=false. Personal public API key from sam.gov (Account Details → Request API Key). Free. Stored encrypted; never logged."
    },
    "naics": {
      "title": "NAICS codes",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "6-digit or prefix, e.g. 541512 or 5415.",
      "prefill": [
        "541512"
      ]
    },
    "agencies": {
      "title": "Agencies",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Names or codes, e.g. Department of Defense, DHS, EPA."
    },
    "keywords": {
      "title": "Keywords",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Free-text keywords matched against opportunity titles."
    },
    "setAside": {
      "title": "Set-aside types",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "SB, 8A, HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, NONE"
    },
    "states": {
      "title": "Place of performance states",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Two-letter US state codes for place of performance (contracts)."
    },
    "noticeTypes": {
      "title": "Notice types",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Filter by notice type, e.g. solicitation, award_notice, grant_posted."
    },
    "postedWithinDays": {
      "title": "Posted within N days",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 14,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 365,
      "description": "Only include opportunities posted within the last N days. Declared product default is **14 days** (Thursday product window). Schedules and Store listing align to 14d; raise if you need a longer lookback (PPE scales with matches).",
      "prefill": 14
    },
    "deadlineAfter": {
      "title": "Deadline after",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "description": "Defaults to today; excludes expired opportunities."
    },
    "since": {
      "title": "Since date",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "description": "ET calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339. Selects HF delta shards with eventDate >= since. Optional for snapshot (serves latest snapshot). For monitor, defaults to a 7-day lookback ending at the latest published delta date.",
      "prefill": "2026-09-21"
    },
    "includeDescriptions": {
      "title": "Include full descriptions",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "When true, fetch full grant synopses (slower).",
      "prefill": false
    },
    "includeContacts": {
      "title": "Include official contacts",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "When true, include SAM point-of-contact fields.",
      "prefill": false
    },
    "enrichTopN": {
      "title": "Incumbents per opportunity (enrich mode)",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 5,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 20,
      "description": "Category leaders (or predecessors) per opportunity in enrich mode."
    },
    "maxItems": {
      "title": "Max items",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 10000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 50000,
      "description": "Hard cap on opportunity rows returned (and billed) after sort by postedDate desc → Sol#. Default 10000. Schema maximum 50000 so a buyer can opt into covering a full Active+14d/30d window (they pay PPE for what they take). Under the default 14d window, Active matches often exceed 10k — runs emit CAP_TRUNCATED + CAP_COVERAGE.covered/total (never silent). Cap always drops the oldest rows.",
      "prefill": 25
    },
    "samBulk": {
      "title": "Use SAM Data Services daily CSV (bulk)",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility; private producer uses SAM Data Services CSV.",
      "prefill": true
    },
    "samEnrichLimit": {
      "title": "SAM API enrich budget",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 5,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 50,
      "description": "Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility.",
      "prefill": 0
    },
    "incumbentMode": {
      "title": "Enrich join mode",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "category_leaders",
        "predecessor"
      ],
      "default": "category_leaders",
      "description": "category_leaders (default): top USASpending recipients by agency×NAICS. predecessor: true prior-awardee/recompete join (stub until PREDECESSOR_JOIN.md ships). Proof schedules must keep default."
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
